reason: My guests come back year after year because I answer them myself, even at midnight. I'm not handing them to a machine run by one young man in Omiš who might be gone next summer, and my laminated sheet already answers the Wi-Fi question for free.
objection: If the robot tells a German family something wrong about parking or check-out, it's my name on the Booking review, not theirs. And a new one-person company - who answers when it breaks in August?
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it working for a year in the apartments of hosts I know personally on the coast, and them telling me their guests liked it and reviews didn't suffer.
